production.name: production-verification
production.canonicalMetadataSource: Authenticated project and D1 captures in the successful trusted-main workflow; not an independent connector resource GET.

limits: Measurements use local workerd, generated technical EPUB fixtures, ephemeral D1 and intercepted provider calls; no live authenticated upload or provider write is claimed.
Backing storage is sampled at explicit checkpoints, not total RSS, native/transient peak memory, CPU or upload throughput. Garbage collection and checkpoint timing affect results.
The 64 MiB admission budget covers application upload buffers per isolate, not all isolate memory or an account-wide quota. Unknown-length small requests conservatively reserve the endpoint maximum.
Two large inputs now admit one request and return a retryable 503 for the other. The lower overlap sample is not a claim of unchanged concurrent throughput.
Production preservation compares authenticated captures; public HTTP and captures are separate reads, not an atomic transaction or a guarantee against later edits.
Private production baselines remain ignored and were not uploaded; the artifact contains only the sanitized report.
No new physical-device, real credential/CAPTCHA or provider-write acceptance is claimed.
